messages:
PagerBot: PagerDuty triggered: auth-proxy-401-spike — page to on-call (sev=2) — incident INC-2026-0042
maddy: oncall ack. I'm looking at dashboards now.
sam: noticed auth 401s up ~12x for /v1/generate, narrow source IPs. 401s correlate with short auth header lengths.
jordan: spike start ~23:04 UTC. ASN lookup -> 396985 (third-party host). user-agent strings include curl/7.8 and python-requests/2.x.
maddy: checking edge logs for XFF & replay. Any traffic patterns beyond /v1/generate?
lia: also seeing repeated attempts to /internal/diagnostics with same tokens.
maddy: potential replay of short-lived tokens. Can we block at WAF immediately?
sam: preparing quick WAF ACL, will push a rule for the observed /32s. Proposed rule id: rw-quick-block-2026.
maddy: go ahead, we want minimal blast radius.
sam: pushing ACL now:
```
edgectl waf apply --rule rw-quick-block-2026 --block 203.0.113.44/30,198.51.100.22/32
```
Propagation ~30s.
PagerBot: Deploy bot: waf-rule-deploy rw-quick-block-2026 succeeded.
jordan: 401s down ~70% in the last minute. Good signal.
maddy: I found a staging debug lambda that was emitting full auth headers into staging-logs-bucket. env DEBUG=true + codepath accidentally logged headers. Suspect root cause.
lia: if staging logs contain live tokens we need immediate rotation for affected service tokens and a purge of the bucket. Avoid customer-facing rotation until scope confirmed.
sam: initiating key-rotate playbook for svc-inference and svc-analytics (short-lived service tokens). Running:
```
/playbooks/key-rotate.sh svc-inference svc-analytics
```
ETA ~6m to update k8s secrets and restart pods.
maddy: paging secops and legal for assessment @legal @secops.
legal: acknowledged. what's current blast radius and data types in logs?
jordan: scanning logs, initial grep shows authorization header strings and request ids, no obvious PII in the samples so far. continuing full scan.
maddy: start purge of affected S3 prefix and lock down bucket ACLs. jordan, can you run the removal and replace with scrubbed files?
jordan: running purge command to remove yesterday/today prefixes then replace with scrubbed placeholders:
```
aws s3 rm s3://staging-logs-bucket/logs/2026/03/17/ --recursive --profile staging-cleanup && aws s3 cp ./scrubbed-placeholder/ s3://staging-logs-bucket/logs/2026/03/17/ --recursive
```
lia: added a temporary RBAC change to analytics read role to prevent further pulls. pushed change to infra; awaiting propagation.
oncall-next: I can take lead for the handoff in 20m. Handoff checklist I need: short summary, actions taken, which keys rotated, which logs purged, and next remediation PR link.
maddy: I'll assemble a summary and post it here before handoff. Keys rotated: svc-inference (yes), svc-analytics (yes). Logs purge: in progress (partial). WAF blocks applied. Postmortem owner: eng-sre/jordan.
sam: follow-ups: add automated scrub of Authorization and Cookie headers in staging log pipeline, add a safeguard that DEBUG env cannot be true in staging pipeline without a gate. Create runbook entry for quick-waf-block id pattern.
legal: we may need to prepare a customer notice if we discover customer tokens. Hold message until secops confirms scope.
secops: running deeper indicator-of-compromise checks across regions, correlating session replays. Will report within 30m.
PagerBot: Incident INC-2026-0042 updated: severity downgraded to sev3 — last update 1718055389
maddy: handing off to @oncall-next in 18m with the summary. Will attach playbook logs and purge confirmations.
oncall-next: ack, will pick up and continue mitigation & postmortem ownership transfer then.
